services.desc: The Wawa Short-Term Rental Accommodation (STR) Licensing By-law was passed at a Regular Meeting of Council on April 16, 2024. Effective this date, all persons who own, operate or offer a STR within the Municipality of Wawa must obtain a license to operate. The creation of Wawa’s STR Licensing Program was a thorough and an inclusive process that involved multiple stages of extensive policy review and development. The initiative included a public consultation, inviting valuable input and perspectives on STRs from the residents and stakeholders.
